svg.aria-label: Where changes go: a kernel option goes in config/kernel; a driver or device tree change is a patch in patches/source; the DTB choice is a line in extlinux.conf; UEFI boot order and mode are set with a config variable or the L4TConfiguration overlay and need the QSPI flash rewritten; user and hostname are config variables; packages and files go into the rootfs directory; pinmux for a custom carrier goes in a new board config and BCT files and also rewrites the QSPI flash.
svg.text: Pick the row that matches what you want to change. Each row says which file to edit, what to re-run, and which part of the board is rewritten.
In the default boot mode the kernel comes from the root filesystem (/boot/Image, selected by /boot/extlinux/extlinux.conf).
On a running board: scp the new Image and modules, keep the old kernel as a second extlinux entry, reboot. No recovery mode.
Exact commands for each row: docs/08-customizing.md. A change that lands in 'boot firmware' rewrites the QSPI-NOR flash, which needs recovery mode again.
